definition: Serious and official; following the rules for special events.
examples: He wore formal clothes to the dinner.
She sent a formal letter to the bank.
This is a formal event, so wear a suit.

spanish.definition: Serio y oficial; que sigue las reglas de eventos especiales.

definition: In a way that must be followed exactly; only.
examples: Smoking is strictly forbidden.
This meeting is strictly for parents.
He follows the rules strictly.

spanish.definition: De forma que se debe seguir con exactitud; solamente.

definition: Related to machines, computers or special knowledge.
examples: We had a technical problem with the sound.
She works in technical support.
This book is too technical for me.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con máquinas, computadoras o conocimiento especial.

definition: A person who takes care of sheep.
examples: The shepherd walked with his sheep.
We have a German shepherd.
He worked as a shepherd in the mountains.

spanish.definition: Persona que cuida ovejas.

definition: Very violent or very hard.
examples: It was a brutal attack.
We had a brutal winter.
She told me the brutal truth.

spanish.definition: Muy violento o muy duro.

definition: Too proud of your looks; without success.
examples: He's so vain about his hair.
We tried in vain to save her.
She's a vain woman who loves mirrors.

spanish.definition: Demasiado orgulloso de tu aspecto; sin éxito.

definition: A large, fast wild animal with long legs.
examples: We saw a deer in the woods.
A deer ran across the road.
There are many deer in this park.

spanish.definition: Animal salvaje, grande y rápido con patas largas.

definition: To stop working because of your age.
examples: My father retired at sixty-five.
She wants to retire early.
He's retiring next year.

spanish.definition: Dejar de trabajar por la edad.

definition: To succeed in dealing with a problem.
examples: She overcame her fear of flying.
We can overcome this problem together.
He has overcome many difficulties in his life.

spanish.definition: Tener éxito al enfrentar un problema.

definition: Something that gives you new ideas or makes you want to do something.
examples: My mother is my inspiration.
He found inspiration in nature.
The artist needs some inspiration.

spanish.definition: Algo que te da ideas nuevas o ganas de hacer algo.

definition: An idea you offer to someone.
examples: Can I make a suggestion?
Thanks for your suggestion.
Do you have any suggestions for dinner?

spanish.definition: Idea que le ofreces a alguien.

definition: A person who works on a ship.
examples: He was a sailor in the navy.
The sailors slept on the ship.
My grandfather was a sailor.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja en un barco.

definition: The place you are going to.
examples: We reached our destination at noon.
Cancún is a popular destination.
What's your final destination?

spanish.definition: Lugar al que vas.

definition: A meal you eat outside.
examples: Let's have a picnic in the park.
We took a picnic to the beach.
The kids love picnics.

spanish.definition: Comida que se hace al aire libre.

definition: A famous person you admire very much; a statue people pray to.
examples: He was my idol when I was a kid.
She met her idol at a concert.
They prayed to a stone idol.

spanish.definition: Persona famosa que admiras mucho; estatua a la que se reza.

definition: A person's level in an organization, such as the army.
examples: What's his rank in the army?
She rose to the rank of captain.
He has a high rank in the police.

spanish.definition: Nivel de una persona en una organización, como el ejército.

definition: Demanding that people follow the rules.
examples: My parents were very strict.
The school has strict rules.
She's a strict teacher.

spanish.definition: Que exige que se sigan las reglas.

definition: A rule in math or science; milk for babies; a way to get a result.
examples: Learn this math formula.
The baby drinks formula.
There's no secret formula for success.

spanish.definition: Regla en matemáticas o ciencia; leche para bebés; forma de lograr algo.

definition: A person who works in a store or an office.
examples: Ask the clerk for help.
The hotel clerk gave me a key.
She's a bank clerk.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja en una tienda u oficina.

definition: A small restaurant that serves coffee and light meals.
examples: Let's meet at the cafe.
There's a little cafe on the corner.
She works in a cafe near the school.

spanish.definition: Restaurante pequeño que sirve café y comidas ligeras.

definition: Not covered; empty.
examples: She walked with bare feet.
The walls are bare.
He killed the snake with his bare hands.

spanish.definition: Que no está cubierto; vacío.

definition: A person who cuts and sells meat.
examples: I bought some steak at the butcher shop.
The butcher cut the meat for me.
My uncle was a butcher.

spanish.definition: Persona que corta y vende carne.

definition: A department of the government; the work of a religious leader.
examples: She works at the Ministry of Education.
He began his ministry at a small church.
The ministry made an announcement today.

spanish.definition: Departamento del gobierno; trabajo de un líder religioso.

definition: To find the place of something; to be in a place.
examples: The police located the car.
The hotel is located near the airport.
We can't locate the file.

spanish.definition: Encontrar el lugar de algo; estar en un lugar.

definition: To look at something very carefully.
examples: The doctor examined my arm.
They're examining the evidence.
She examined the ring under the light.

spanish.definition: Mirar algo con mucho cuidado.

definition: A stick of wax that gives light when you burn it.
examples: She lit a candle.
There were ten candles on the cake.
We had dinner by candlelight.

spanish.definition: Barra de cera que da luz cuando se quema.

definition: Earlier; happening before.
examples: Do you have any prior experience?
He has a prior meeting.
She left two days prior to the wedding.

spanish.definition: Anterior; que pasa antes.

definition: A small river; to watch or listen online.
examples: We crossed a small stream.
The kids play by the stream.
I streamed the movie on my TV.

spanish.definition: Río pequeño; ver o escuchar por internet.

definition: A part of the body with a special job; a large musical instrument in a church.
examples: The heart is an organ.
She plays the organ at church.
He gave one of his organs to his brother.

spanish.definition: Parte del cuerpo con un trabajo especial; instrumento grande de una iglesia.

definition: Something expensive and comfortable that you don't really need.
examples: They live in luxury.
We stayed at a luxury hotel.
A second car is a luxury.

spanish.definition: Algo caro y cómodo que en realidad no necesitas.

definition: A small gun.
examples: The officer pulled out his pistol.
He had a pistol under his coat.
The police found the pistol in the car.

spanish.definition: Arma de fuego pequeña.

definition: A large place to bury a dead person.
examples: We visited the king's tomb.
They discovered an old tomb in Egypt.
Flowers covered the tomb.

spanish.definition: Lugar grande para enterrar a un muerto.

definition: A small rubber bag filled with air.
examples: The kids got balloons at the party.
The red balloon flew away.
We went up in a hot air balloon.

spanish.definition: Bolsa pequeña de caucho llena de aire.

definition: To send out a TV or radio program; a TV or radio program.
examples: The game was broadcast around the world.
We watched the news broadcast.
They're broadcasting live from Paris.

spanish.definition: Enviar un programa de TV o radio; programa de TV o radio.

definition: To put a liquid on something in very small drops; a liquid in a can.
examples: She sprayed perfume on her neck.
He sprayed the plants with water.
I need some bug spray.

spanish.definition: Poner un líquido sobre algo en gotas muy pequeñas; líquido en lata.

definition: Useful; easy to reach.
examples: This little knife is very handy.
Keep your phone handy.
He's handy with tools.

spanish.definition: Útil; fácil de alcanzar.

definition: A thin, flat piece of food; to cut food into thin pieces.
examples: Can I have a slice of pizza?
She sliced the tomatoes.
He ate two slices of bread.

spanish.definition: Pedazo delgado y plano de comida; cortar comida en pedazos delgados.

definition: The speed of something; a single step.
examples: She walks at a fast pace.
Life moves at a slower pace here.
He took two paces back.

spanish.definition: Velocidad de algo; un solo paso.

definition: Hard and not easy to bend; painful when moving.
examples: My neck is stiff this morning.
This new shirt is stiff.
I have stiff legs after the race.

spanish.definition: Duro y difícil de doblar; que duele al moverse.

definition: To move your tongue over something.
examples: The dog licked my hand.
She licked the ice cream.
Don't lick your fingers.

spanish.definition: Pasar la lengua sobre algo.

definition: A hard building material; real and clear.
examples: The floor is made of concrete.
We need concrete proof.
They built a concrete wall.

spanish.definition: Material duro de construcción; real y claro.

definition: A plant you eat, such as a carrot.
examples: Eat your vegetables.
We grow vegetables in the yard.
She made a vegetable soup.

spanish.definition: Planta que se come, como la zanahoria.

definition: Meat in a long, thin skin.
examples: We had eggs and sausage for breakfast.
He put a sausage on the grill.
This sausage is too spicy.

spanish.definition: Carne dentro de una piel larga y delgada.

definition: Related to genes.
examples: It's a genetic disease.
They did a genetic test.
Eye color is genetic.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con los genes.

definition: A train system under a city.
examples: I take the subway to work.
The subway was very crowded.
Is there a subway station near here?

spanish.definition: Sistema de trenes bajo una ciudad.

definition: To move slowly and quietly; an unpleasant person.
examples: He crept up the stairs.
The cat was creeping toward the bird.
That guy is a creep.

spanish.definition: Moverse despacio y en silencio; persona desagradable.

definition: A plan, often a dishonest one.
examples: They lost money in a get-rich scheme.
It's another of his crazy schemes.
The police discovered the scheme.

spanish.definition: Plan, a menudo deshonesto.

definition: The end of a wire that connects to electricity; to close a hole.
examples: Pull the plug out of the wall.
Plug the hole with a cloth.
He plugged in the lamp.

spanish.definition: Extremo de un cable que se conecta a la electricidad; cerrar un hueco.

definition: One of the two organs that clean your blood.
examples: He needs a new kidney.
She has kidney disease.
He gave a kidney to his brother.

spanish.definition: Uno de los dos órganos que limpian la sangre.

definition: When an army enters another country by force.
examples: The invasion began at dawn.
This is an invasion of my privacy.
The movie is about an alien invasion.

spanish.definition: Cuando un ejército entra a otro país por la fuerza.

definition: A feeling of love or liking.
examples: She looked at him with affection.
Kids need affection.
He shows his affection with gifts.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de cariño.

definition: Control of behavior through rules; the ability to control yourself.
examples: You need discipline to learn a language.
The school has very strict discipline.
He has no discipline.

spanish.definition: Control del comportamiento con reglas; capacidad de controlarte.

definition: Not being in a place.
examples: She ran the store during his absence.
Nobody noticed his absence.
He has three absences this month.

spanish.definition: No estar en un lugar.

definition: The study of ideas about life; a personal way of thinking.
examples: She studied philosophy in college.
What's your philosophy of life?
He has a simple philosophy: be kind.

spanish.definition: Estudio de las ideas sobre la vida; forma personal de pensar.

definition: The decision of a jury in court.
examples: The jury reached a verdict.
The verdict was guilty.
We're waiting for the verdict.

spanish.definition: Decisión de un jurado en un juicio.

definition: A special right that only some people have.
examples: It was a privilege to meet her.
He grew up with wealth and privilege.
Driving is a privilege, not a right.

spanish.definition: Derecho especial que solo tienen algunas personas.

definition: Believing too easily that people are good.
examples: I was young and naive.
Don't be so naive.
She has a naive view of politics.

spanish.definition: Que cree muy fácil que la gente es buena.

definition: The natural light of the day.
examples: We need to get home before daylight ends.
He was robbed in broad daylight.
The room gets a lot of daylight.

spanish.definition: Luz natural del día.

definition: A vehicle with wings that flies.
examples: I've never been on an airplane.
The airplane landed in Denver.
My son wants to fly airplanes.

spanish.definition: Vehículo con alas que vuela.

definition: Happy and friendly.
examples: He's a jolly old man.
He has a jolly laugh.
Santa is a jolly man in a red suit.

spanish.definition: Feliz y amistoso.

definition: Permission to do something.
examples: She gave her consent to the surgery.
They got married without their parents' consent.
You need written consent from a parent.

spanish.definition: Permiso para hacer algo.

definition: A game that you solve by thinking; something hard to understand.
examples: We did a puzzle with a thousand pieces.
She loves crossword puzzles.
His behavior is a puzzle to me.

spanish.definition: Juego que se resuelve pensando; algo difícil de entender.

definition: To have a different opinion.
examples: I disagree with you.
They're always disagreeing about money.
She disagreed with the decision.

spanish.definition: Tener una opinión diferente.

definition: A man in stories who has magic powers.
examples: Harry Potter is a young wizard.
The old wizard lives in a tower.
He's a wizard with computers.

spanish.definition: Hombre de los cuentos con poderes mágicos.

definition: A famous person.
examples: She's a big celebrity in Mexico.
I saw a celebrity at the airport.
Many celebrities live in Los Angeles.

spanish.definition: Persona famosa.

definition: Useful and easy; good for your plans.
examples: This store is very convenient.
Is six o'clock convenient for you?
Paying by phone is convenient.

spanish.definition: Útil y fácil; bueno para tus planes.

definition: Extra money from your job; something good that you didn't expect.
examples: I got a Christmas bonus.
She got a big bonus this year.
The free lunch was a nice bonus.

spanish.definition: Dinero extra de tu trabajo; algo bueno que no esperabas.

definition: A natural way of behaving that you don't have to learn.
examples: Follow your instincts.
Birds know by instinct how to build a nest.
My first instinct was to run.

spanish.definition: Forma natural de actuar que no hay que aprender.

definition: The part of your body between your hand and your arm.
examples: She broke her wrist.
He wore a watch on his wrist.
My wrist hurts from typing.

spanish.definition: Parte del cuerpo entre la mano y el brazo.

definition: To let liquid flow out of something; a pipe that takes water away.
examples: Drain the pasta before you add the sauce.
The kitchen drain is blocked.
They drained the pool.

spanish.definition: Dejar salir el líquido de algo; tubo que se lleva el agua.

definition: The science of matter and energy.
examples: She teaches physics.
I failed my physics test.
He has a degree in physics.

spanish.definition: Ciencia de la materia y la energía.

definition: Very angry.
examples: My dad was furious when he saw the car.
She's furious with me.
He sent a furious email.

spanish.definition: Muy enojado.

definition: The money you get from your job or business.
examples: We live on a small income.
What's your yearly income?
Rent takes half of my income.

spanish.definition: Dinero que recibes de tu trabajo o negocio.

definition: A very strong, narrow beam of light.
examples: The doctor fixed my eyes with a laser.
My cat loves to chase the laser.
The machine cuts metal with a laser.

spanish.definition: Rayo de luz muy fuerte y delgado.

definition: Correct and exact.
examples: This clock is very accurate.
Is this information accurate?
She gave an accurate description of the man.

spanish.definition: Correcto y exacto.

definition: The short, thick finger on your hand.
examples: I hurt my thumb.
The baby sucks his thumb.
He gave me a thumbs-up.

spanish.definition: Dedo corto y grueso de la mano.

definition: Having no hair on your head.
examples: My uncle is bald.
He's going bald.
The man has a bald head.

spanish.definition: Sin pelo en la cabeza.

definition: A feeling that someone did something wrong.
examples: He was arrested on suspicion of robbery.
I have a suspicion that she's lying.
She looked at him with suspicion.

spanish.definition: Sensación de que alguien hizo algo malo.

definition: The large room at the entrance of a hotel or building.
examples: I'll meet you in the hotel lobby.
The lobby was full of people.
There's a coffee shop in the lobby.

spanish.definition: Sala grande a la entrada de un hotel o edificio.

definition: Instructions for cooking something.
examples: Can you give me the recipe for this cake?
This is my grandmother's recipe.
I found a new recipe online.

spanish.definition: Instrucciones para cocinar algo.

definition: To say something officially.
examples: The country declared war.
He was declared the winner.
Do you have anything to declare at customs?

spanish.definition: Decir algo oficialmente.

definition: A flying weapon that explodes.
examples: They fired a missile at the ship.
The missile hit the city.
The country tested a new missile.

spanish.definition: Arma voladora que explota.

definition: To make sure of something.
examples: Please ensure that the door is locked.
We ensure the quality of our food.
The rules ensure everyone's safety.

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo sea seguro o cierto.

definition: Difficult to do or to deal with.
examples: That's a tricky question.
It's a tricky situation.
Parking here can be tricky.

spanish.definition: Difícil de hacer o de manejar.

definition: A game played on ice with sticks.
examples: Hockey is very popular in Canada.
He plays hockey in the winter.
We went to a hockey game.

spanish.definition: Juego sobre hielo con palos.

definition: A small ball of air in a liquid.
examples: The kids are blowing bubbles.
There are bubbles in my soda.
She took a bubble bath.

spanish.definition: Bola pequeña de aire dentro de un líquido.

definition: The largest possible amount.
examples: The maximum speed here is fifty.
You can take a maximum of two bags.
The maximum is twenty dollars per person.

spanish.definition: La mayor cantidad posible.

definition: A piece of cloth that covers a window.
examples: Please close the curtains.
She bought new curtains for the living room.
The curtain went up and the show began.

spanish.definition: Tela que cubre una ventana.

definition: A person who writes books.
examples: She's my favorite author.
The author signed my book.
Who's the author of this novel?

spanish.definition: Persona que escribe libros.

definition: Not able to live forever; causing death.
examples: All men are mortal.
He died of a mortal wound.
We're only mortal.

spanish.definition: Que no puede vivir para siempre; que causa la muerte.

definition: Telling the truth.
examples: I value your honesty.
Honesty is the best policy.
Thanks for your honesty.

spanish.definition: Decir la verdad.

definition: A small computer you can carry.
examples: I work on my laptop at home.
She left her laptop on the train.
This laptop has a great battery.

spanish.definition: Computadora pequeña que puedes llevar.

definition: An arc of colors in the sky after rain.
examples: Look at the rainbow!
A rainbow has seven colors.
The kids drew a rainbow.

spanish.definition: Arco de colores en el cielo después de llover.

definition: Behaving like an adult; fully grown.
examples: She's very mature for her age.
Be mature about this.
Mature trees give a lot of shade.

spanish.definition: Que se comporta como adulto; que ya creció del todo.

definition: A person who attacks and robs ships.
examples: The pirates took the ship.
My son wants a pirate costume.
The old pirate had a wooden leg.

spanish.definition: Persona que ataca y roba barcos.

definition: The time after you stop working because of your age.
examples: He's enjoying his retirement in Florida.
We're saving for retirement.
They gave her a retirement party.

spanish.definition: Tiempo después de dejar de trabajar por la edad.

definition: The place at a station where you get on a train; a raised floor for speakers.
examples: The train leaves from platform two.
She stood on the platform and spoke.
He waited on the platform for an hour.

spanish.definition: Lugar de una estación donde subes al tren; piso alto para hablar.

definition: A person who travels for fun.
examples: Miami is full of tourists.
I feel like a tourist here.
The tourist asked for directions.

spanish.definition: Persona que viaja por diversión.

definition: A person who travels in a vehicle but doesn't drive it.
examples: The bus has thirty passengers.
She sat in the passenger seat.
All passengers must show a ticket.

spanish.definition: Persona que viaja en un vehículo pero no lo conduce.

definition: A very small animal with six legs.
examples: An insect bit me on the arm.
Bees are useful insects.
There are insects all over the kitchen.

spanish.definition: Animal muy pequeño con seis patas.
